basis: All 57 source references audited. All 46 supported CC0 references now submitted to actual unchanged production inference; supported category is not approval. Five unsupported multi-piece/ethnic references and six research references without established commercial rights excluded.

sourceRisks.all: Community references are mostly 400 px wide; source resolution and non-studio backgrounds limit fine detail. Real parser and output checks are still required.
sourceRisks.edit-80653ab3: Printed lettering must remain recognizable; reject invented lettering.
sourceRisks.edit-ddfd02ed: Pleats and sheer details need full-resolution output review.
sourceRisks.edit-d5964c78: Hood transfer must not change hair/head or introduce extra layers.
sourceRisks.edit-29864eb0: Open-front construction may expose original shirt; judge layering explicitly.
sourceRisks.edit-39a96b4e: Shorts must preserve exposed skin and both leg boundaries.
sourceRisks.edit-b4b507dd: Checked pattern and open-front layering must be preserved; wood background needs actual mask review.
sourceRisks.edit-98ec0a37: Sleeveless construction and tie neckline must survive; requires a person photo with compatible arm exposure.
sourceRisks.edit-9b76f08a: Ribbing, lace trim and cropped sleeveless hem must survive; pink background must not become fabric.
sourceRisks.edit-c4010e8b: Fine pattern and fitted leg construction must remain; bedding background must not become extra clothing.

deferred.editorial-outfits: Five layered/draped ethnic references lack a supported model mapping.
deferred.research-references: Six original demo/product references lack established commercial image publication rights; retained in archive, not candidates for a production wardrobe.
deferred.remaining-licensed-references: Reserve pool: folded/cropped sleeves, thin straps, small product occupancy, busy prints or backgrounds require additional review if the primary pool falls short.

reserveExpansion: Ten reserve references reviewed after the initial 28 fell short. Added four complete-outline shirt/top/leggings references on 28 October for real baseline and segmentation checks. They remain unapproved; patterned backgrounds, thin trim and sleeve coverage are risks, not automatic successes.
